zh.title: 交个朋友！🤝
paragraphs: 欢迎飞书 Ping 我！如果大家在北京或来北京出差，欢迎 Coffee Chat，我来请奶茶！🧋
平时如果喜欢打篮球 🏀、听音乐会 🎵、看话剧音乐剧 🎭，也可以一起呀，希望能够找到组织！

en.title: Let's Connect! 🤝
paragraphs: Feel free to ping me on Feishu/Lark! If you're in Beijing or passing through, let's grab a coffee — bubble tea's on me! 🧋
If you enjoy basketball 🏀, concerts 🎵, or musicals 🎭, let's hang out — always looking for like-minded friends!
